title: cyanotis zebrina
intro: Cyanotis zebrina, commonly known as the Zebra Leaf or Zebra Plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Commelinaceae. This plant is known for its unique striped leaves, which have been used in traditional medicine for various health benefits, including reducing fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
